headline: Dangote Refinery Boosts IPO Size to $2.1B After Strong Demand
summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery will raise its planned initial public offering target from $1.62 billion to $2.1 billion after drawing nearly $4.5 billion in investor demand.
why: The 650,000-barrel-per-day Dangote refinery in Nigeria is Africa's largest processing facility, with significant implications for regional fuel supply and Nigerian capital markets.

impacts.name: Dangote Petroleum Refinery
impacts.why: Investor demand exceeded the initial IPO target, allowing management to increase deal proceeds.
